rules.text: Trim outer whitespace; preserve original text and case; no truncation.
rules.identifier: Require exactly 11 ASCII digits as a string; format validity is not registry verification.
rules.postcode: Require exactly four ASCII digits as a string; preserve leading zeroes.
rules.url: Accept http/https URLs without credentials; retain invalid source text as private evidence; do not invent a scheme.
rules.date: Parse valid DD/MM/YYYY to ISO date. Pilot-observed format; reject other formats for review. Do not infer date precision beyond the source.
rules.calendar: Parse DD-Mon using explicit English month names into month/day, with leap-day support and no invented year; preserve source text.
rules.count: Parse nonnegative decimal integer; reject fractional, signed, negative or nonnumeric values.
rules.flag: Explicit Y/N -> true/false; null/blank -> unknown. Other tokens require qualification, not Python truthiness.
rules.other_names: Preserve supplied text as one unclassified other-name value; splitting and alias type need source delimiter qualification.
rules.countries: Preserve supplied country-code text; split/code vocabulary requires qualification before array projection. Do not infer from address country.
rules.native_id: Retain resource-scoped CKAN row ID for traceability only; not a stable cross-release organisation identifier.

destination_design: acnc_register_details stores typed scalars and validated address/flag objects per organisation/source record. F03 adds selected publication, source-scoped revisions, attribution and suppression. F04 renders latest approved source observations in existing public sections through a narrow public RPC; disagreements remain separate, and private/suppressed facts are excluded. Address components are an atomic merge; flags are independently selectable. Pilot replay remains F05.
qualification_gates: Only pilot-observed DD/MM/YYYY dates, DD-Mon calendars and Y/N flags are accepted; other formats quarantine records for qualification. Synthetic fixtures test validation, not broader source-format qualification.
Other-name delimiter/type and country-list vocabulary remain unresolved: supplied text is preserved without splitting.
Schema, transformations, selected publication and public rendering are implemented and locally tested. Retained-pilot replay and the full release gate remain F05.

upstream_references.use: Field inventory; correct duplicate address keys, misspellings and source-key mismatches.
Destination reference; replace truthiness conversions and silent truncation.
